title: How many Urology and Continence Supply Programs one customer may hold
content:
A customer may hold up to 2 Urology and Continence Supply Programs at the same time, each for a different product line. An example is intermittent catheters together with absorbent products, where the tier covers them.

## Opening a new program

A new continence program is opened only when the customer has no continence program of the same product line in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold. It is never opened for a product line that is paired, under the indwelling catheter exclusion, with a product line the customer already holds in one of those statuses. The excluded pairs are indwelling with intermittent, and indwelling with external. A closed program does not count. The test reads the customer's programs on file, by product line and status.

| Hypothetical existing programs | Request | Opened? |
|---|---|---|
| intermittent catheter, active | absorbent products | yes, as the second program |
| intermittent catheter, on hold | intermittent catheter | no: same product line, on hold |
| intermittent catheter, closed | intermittent catheter | yes: a closed program does not count |
| external catheter, pending authorization | indwelling catheter | no: an excluded pair |
